x: Taylor also did well in his first big race but Len Bishop found the going very heavy as did Abbott but John Lacey kept plugging away and Evison and Budd, two comparative newcomers to our ranks, performed quite well in a field of 219 starters.

In the team race Blackheath were 2nd with 48 points to our 44 and Sutton & Cheam 3rd with 79. Budd the handicap winner, was a last minute entry and although running well, must thank the handicapper for a somewhat generous allowance.
